title: 第5章 我又悟了第6章 残血夜奔
slug: 看见血条的我选择打爆世界
content_zh:
自从周元开始研究吃饭、睡觉两件事后，他的疯癫名号就变得更响了。
这也不能怪村民们大惊小怪，实在是周元的举动太过奇怪。
原本他虽然说话混账、下手贼狠，但至少能正常交流，活得也像模像样。
现在他却将馍馍当作珍宝，明明几口就能吃完的东西，非要细嚼慢咽，宛若在吃什么山珍海味。
如果仅仅是这样，村民们还会说这孩子憨厚，一看就是实在人。
可他不是慢慢吃一顿，而是一顿吃几口，一天吃上二三十次。
这频率吓坏了看护他的村汉，以为他疯癫加剧，不知饥饱了。
“石头，你别想不开啊，你要是把自个撑死了，下了地府也得被鬼嘲笑。
你要是想吃点好的，你就直说，犯不着换着样的吓唬俺。”
“大黄叔，你活够了，不懂没活够的心。
我这是防患于未然，从军前尽量多吃几顿，免得从军后连个馍馍都吃不上。
不过，你说的也有道理，赶明儿给我整点好的吧，说不定吃几顿好的，我就不惦记馍馍了。”
“呸，你这瓜娃子说的都是什么话，什么叫我活够了，你才活够了。
不像话，太不像话了，从军要是一口馍馍都不给，谁他娘的给那些老爷们打仗啊。
阎王还不差饿肚子鬼呐，偌大的军营少不了你一口吃的。”
“那可不一定，我要是将军就专门派几支骑兵烧粮草，保管对面饿的嗷嗷叫。”
“你这都是从哪听的歪理，咱们是服兵役，又不是去打仗。
兵役你懂吗，就是替换老卒、运粮挖沟、伐木修墙，活儿多着那，想当战兵也得被选上不是。”
“那惨了，我说你这老头怎么一点也不担心，原来是村里青壮多，你不用顶在最前面啊。”
“嘿嘿，这就是年纪大的好处，你们这些毛头小子学着点吧。”

赵大黄看周元还能正常交流，没有疯癫入脑，不由大大的松了一口气。
这邪门小子，脑瓜歪的很，还是早点送到军营比较好，不然非惹出什么大事不可。
三个看护周元的村汉，本以为赵大黄已经劝住周元了。
可没想到这小子嘴上说一套、做事儿又一套，仿佛他的脑瓜根本管不住他的身体。
第二天一早，周元不仅故技重施，而且变得更抽象了。
“哥几个，我昨晚琢磨了一宿，悟出了武道真意。
这习武之道贵在一张一弛、一静一动，这动功我们都刷上两下，主要是这静功。
你们想，既要静又要休息，这两者合起来不就是睡觉嘛。”
“从今天起，我要练刀练枪、随时睡觉，保管能练出一副好体魄。”
三个村汉你看看我、我看看你，一时间竟不知如何作答。
“坏了大黄叔，我竟然觉得石头说的有点道理，我是不是也疯了。”
“砰！”
赵大黄重重捶了一下村汉的胸膛，那眼神儿仿佛要吃人。
“胡闹，说什么屁话呢，那叫机灵懂吗，你也变机灵了。
你要是不想做咱们十里八村有名的机灵人，就管好自个的臭嘴。”
“呜···，俺晓得了，俺最老实了，一点都不机灵。
大黄叔，要不换个人看护石头，这样下去咱们早晚得被他祸祸咯。”
“再看看，石头就是机灵了点，心应该不坏···”
content_en:
Ever since Zhou Yuan started studying eating and sleeping, his reputation as crazy has become even louder.
We can't blame the villagers for making a fuss, it's really Zhou Yuan's behavior that is too strange.
Originally, although he spoke rudely and was cruel, he could at least communicate normally and live a decent life.
Now he regards steamed buns as a treasure. He can eat them in just a few bites, but he insists on chewing them slowly, as if he is eating some delicacy from the mountains and seas.
If it were just like this, the villagers would still say that this child is honest and honest, and he is a real person at first glance.
But instead of eating slowly, he eats several bites at a time, twenty or thirty times a day.
This frequency frightened the villagers who took care of him, thinking that he was getting mad and did not know whether he was hungry or full.
"Stone, don't think too hard. If you push yourself to death, you will be laughed at by ghosts when you get to the underworld.
If you want to eat something good, just say so, don't try to scare me in any way. "
"Uncle Dahuang, you have lived enough, and you don't understand the heart of someone who has not lived enough.
I am trying to take precautions before joining the army. I try to eat as many meals as possible before joining the army, so as not to be unable to eat even one steamed bun after joining the army.
However, what you said makes sense. Give me something good tomorrow. Maybe after a few good meals, I won't miss the buns anymore. "
"Bah, what are you talking about, you little melon? What do you mean, I have lived enough, and you have lived enough.
It's outrageous, it's outrageous. If you don't get a bite of steamed buns from joining the army, then who the hell is going to fight for those old men?
The king of hell is not bad at all, you are a hungry ghost, you are indispensable for such a huge military camp. "
"That's not necessarily the case. If I were a general, I would send a few cavalry to burn food and grass to keep the hungry people on the other side howling."
"Where did you get all this nonsense? We are serving in the military, not fighting.
Do you know that military service is about replacing old soldiers, transporting grain, digging ditches, felling trees and building walls? There are so many jobs, you have to be selected if you want to be a soldier. "
"That's terrible. Why don't you, old man, worry at all? It turns out there are many young people in the village, so you don't need to be at the front."
"Hehe, this is the advantage of being older. You young boys should learn from it."
Zhao Dahuang breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that Zhou Yuan could still communicate normally and was not crazy.
This evil boy has a very crooked mind. It would be better to send him to the military camp as soon as possible, otherwise he will cause some big trouble.
The three village men who were looking after Zhou Yuan thought that Zhao Dahuang had already persuaded Zhou Yuan to stop.
But I didn't expect that this kid would say one thing and do another thing, as if his mind couldn't control his body at all.
Early the next morning, Zhou Yuan not only repeated his old tricks, but also became more abstract.
"Brothers, I spent the whole night thinking about it last night and realized the true meaning of martial arts.
The key to practicing martial arts is to relax, be still and move at one time. We practice both the moving skills twice, and the main thing is the static skills.
You think, if you need both quietness and rest, wouldn’t the combination of the two mean sleep? "
"From today on, I will practice swordsmanship and spear shooting, and sleep at any time to ensure that I can develop a good physique."
The three villagers looked at me and I looked at you, and for a moment they didn't know how to answer.
"Uncle Big Huang, I actually think what Shitou said makes sense. Am I also crazy?"
"Bang!"
Zhao Dahuang punched the village man on the chest hard, his eyes as if he wanted to eat someone.
"Nonsense, what nonsense are you talking about? That's smart, you know? You've become smart too.
If you don't want to be a famous smart person in our ten miles and eight villages, just keep your bad mouth in check. "
"Ugh..., I understand, I am the most honest, not clever at all.
Uncle Big Huang, if you don't find someone else to look after the stone, we will be in trouble sooner or later if this continues. "
"Look again, the stone is a little smarter, and his heart shouldn't be bad..."
